win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. Each winning combination of matching symbols creates a winning way. The number of possible ways in this game is 1024. Please consult the paytable for t

wilds.name: WILD MYSTERY MULTIPLIERS
wilds.behavior:
Spooky Mystery Multipliers can drastically increase your winnings. Every time you get a wild symbol as part of a winning way, the wild will be replaced by a multiplier symbol. If you get several multipliers as part of a win, the multipliers shown will multiply. The multipliers will randomly take on a value of either 2, 3 or 5.

Example: If you get a win of 10 times your bet from the winning symbols and your win contains two wilds with multipliers 5 and 3, your win will be 10 * 5 * 3 = 150 times your bet! The max multiplier from this feature is 625x your win.

The wild symbol substitutes for all symbols except the BONUS and FREE SPINS symbols.

modes.name: BONUS GAME
modes.trigger:
Three or more "bonus" scatter symbols in the same spin triggers the spooky bonus wheel!

The bonus wheel consists of three levels.
modes.effects:
Three or more "bonus" scatter symbols in the same spin triggers the spooky bonus wheel!

The bonus wheel consists of three levels. Each level contains a number of possible outcomes - an arrow, a multiplier or a free spin win. If the wheel comes to a stop on an arrow symbol, you advance to the next level with even higher potential winnings and free spin possibilities!

If you hit a free spin symbol, you will be awarded with the FREE SPIN game with the shown number of free spins.

If you hit a multiplier, you will be awarded a fixed win of the shown number times your bet.

The bonus symbol appears in the base game only.

modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: land three or more FREE SPIN symbols in the main game the free spin mode is triggered.
modes.effects: If you land three or more FREE SPIN symbols in the main game the free spin mode is triggered. 3 symbols gives 8 spins, 4 symbols 12 spins and 5 symbols 20 spins. If you win free spins in the bonus game, you will return to the reels but now in free spin mode. The free spin mode has even more wilds with multipliers. If you land three or more FREE SPIN symbols, you will be awarded with an additional 5 freespins. This feature can award extra free spins up to 10 times. Free spins will play automatically until there are no free spins left.
